Visibility and Tracking

ジオフェンス

A virtual perimeter defined by GPS coordinates used in logistics to trigger alerts, monitor asset movement, or enforce location-based controls when shipments, vehicles, or containers enter or exit a designated area, as referenced in fleet management and security protocols.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is ジオフェンス?

In this glossary, ジオフェンス refers to: A virtual perimeter defined by GPS coordinates used in logistics to trigger alerts, monitor asset movement, or enforce location-based controls when shipments, vehicles, or containers enter or exit a designated area, as referenced in fleet management and security protocols.

How is ジオフェンス used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "配送センターの周囲にジオフェンスを設定し、トラックの出入りごとにフリート監視システムで自動警告が発動します。"

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

A virtual perimeter defined by GPS coordinates used in logistics to trigger alerts, monitor asset movement, or enforce location-based controls when shipments, vehicles, or containers enter or exit a designated area, as referenced in fleet management and security protocols.

Operational example

A geo fence is set around the distribution center so that any truck entering or leaving triggers an automated alert in the fleet monitoring system.

Localized term

ジオフェンス

Localized example
